theme_context.purpose: Instagram public data tracker and analytics assistant for a marketer
theme_context.vibe: Cyberpunk Detective / Intelligence Analyst. High-tech, data-heavy, stealthy, and authoritative.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Tech. High contrast weights, technical precision.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. Emphasize tracking-tight and font-black for top-level headers.

body.usage: Use for general paragraphs, labels, and forms.

mono.usage: Use exclusively for numeric data, metrics, follower counts, and tags.

colors.strategy: Deep void dark backgrounds (tinted with blue) with highly luminous electric blue and cyber teal accents to highlight data without overwhelming the eyes.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look): Use border-collapse style layouts for data tables and feature grids. Use Flat Solid backgrounds with a sharp 1px border for dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for sticky headers or floating navs. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B101E]/70 border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.shadows_and_glows: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or drop-shadows with colored glow (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(37,99,235,0.4)]) for active elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle roundness: maximum 8px border-radius (`rounded-md`). Do not use heavily rounded elements.

dashboard_grid.rules: High Density Grid mode. Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to stretch.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to prevent text collision. Use py-12 to py-20 for section separation.

component_rules.buttons: Sharp/Slightly rounded buttons (rounded-md). Active/Primary buttons use electric blue background with white text and a subtle glow on hover.
component_rules.cards: Cardless or strictly rectangular flat styles. 1px border. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and border color shifts to electric blue/teal.
component_rules.tables: Dense rows. Left-align text, right-align numbers. Hover states on rows must slightly lighten the background.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn customized inputs. Background #0B101E, border #1E293B. Focus ring must be electric blue.
component_rules.badges: For Instagram tags or activity types, use small pill shapes with a very subtle background tint (e.g., bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must transition explicitly (e.g., transition-colors duration-200).
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up for list items in Activity Feed and Profile Tracker.
motion.charts: Animate chart rendering on load (Recharts supports this natively).

relationship_map.purpose: Visualizing Ties & Trails / Interaction patterns between accounts.
relationship_map.implementation: Use dark mode settings. Nodes should be tinted electric blue and teal based on account category. Links should have a subtle opacity (0.3) that highlights on node hover.

charts.purpose: Activity Reports, engagement trends, follower growth.
charts.implementation: Use the chart_palette colors defined in this JSON. Customize tooltips to have dark backgrounds (#0B101E) and white text.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5. Tint icons to secondary/muted unless they represent an active state.

image_urls.description: Portraits to use as profile pictures in Search, Tracker, and Dashboard.
Use sparingly as a background texture for the AI Insights panel or Hero search section with a heavy black/void overlay.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over cards has at least a 4.5:1 ratio. The primary action colors (electric blue/teal) must be legible against #030712.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, and chart containers MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='track-profile-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the Google Fonts (@import statements) into src/index.css.
Update tailwind.config.js to set up the color variables (electric-blue, cyber-teal) and border radius (var(--radius)).
DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for headings. Apply font-heading (Chivo) for H1-H4 and font-mono (JetBrains Mono) for numbers.
Ensure dark mode is forced by default.
Build the dashboard using a sidebar navigation (Sherlock logo, Dash, Tracker, Feed, Map, Reports) and a main content area.

For the 'Relationship Map', if react-force-graph is too complex to wire up immediately, build a high-fidelity visual placeholder or a simple Recharts node diagram, but prioritize a real graph if possible.
Apply custom scrollbar styling in index.css (dark track, subtle blue thumb).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on floating elements. Always use bg-opacity with backdrop-blur.
Add 'data-testid' to every actionable UI element.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (headers/navs).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md with interaction animations & relevant colors).
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent uses placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
